# Garrowby Farms - grain-shed telemetry configuration

`grain-shed-telemetry` watches temperature and humidity probes in the grain sheds and raises relay alerts to the farm office.

Two config layers apply: config/grain-shed-telemetry.json is the production instance config and config/grain-shed-defaults.json is the platform defaults. A key set in the instance config wins; any key the instance config does not set falls back to the defaults. A key in neither layer has no value at all.

turns.prompt: Garrowby Farms is wiring the grain-shed telemetry service into the new moisture dashboard and needs the effective moisture_alert_threshold of grain-shed-telemetry. What is it?
